name: @red-cup-engineering/flatfile-engineering-services-section
description: Plain flatfile: whole-file atomic text write (temp + fsync + rename), synchronous UTF-8 whole-file text read (readFlatfileText), a binarity sniff over a regular file's leading bytes, and a plain classifier for the file -> regular-file -> flatfile spine. A flatfile is a NUL-free regular file -- the base byte-touch every text codec composes.
